title: HackerEarth: Monk and Chamber of Secrets
description: Monk visits a chamber with spiders having powers given in `arr`. In each of `x` iterations: dequeue `x` spiders, find the one with maximum power (earliest in tie), record its 1-based original index, and re-queue remaining spiders with power decremented by 1 (clamped to 0). Return list of chosen 1-based indices.
constraints:
1 <= x <= len(arr) <= 1000
• Time: O(x^2) | Space: O(N)
